approach.method_basis: The Parent evolves scored molecular graphs. It draws breeding parents from ranked quantiles of a greedy survivor population, applies graph mutation walks or connected-fragment crossover, and admits fresh, canonically distinct offspring only if they do not introduce excess outside-envelope sulfur signatures relative to their original scored parents. For each fresh surplus pool it fits a Gaussian process to the full chronological accepted archive using chirality-aware Morgan occurrence counts and generalized Tanimoto covariance. It normalizes scores by the archive mean and population standard deviation, samples correlated functions over the pool, and evaluates sequential distinct sample maximizers. Real accepted feedback updates both the archive and survivors.
approach.novelty: Replace the covariance with one fixed inner product of unit-normalized count vectors. This asks whether agreement in relative local-environment composition supplies a more useful predictive and exploration geometry. It preserves the count vocabulary and correlated sampling but deliberately removes overall count magnitude: proportional count rows alias. The siblings tested squared Tanimoto, exponential mean or residual substitutions, and removal of active selection; none tested this linear count-direction law. Earlier normalized-count Matern used Euclidean distance and a positive disjoint-covariance floor, whereas this law gives zero to disjoint nonzero rows and has no lengthscale or fitted parameter.

observed_bottleneck: The limiting behavior is unreliable absolute productive exploration despite exercised learned allocation, not an established covariance defect. Direct inspection of all three actual Parent n-1744a1494180 summary.json/run.log pairs shows complete five-task panels, macro mean 0.59645311428869, population SD 0.03397032998399878 and seed macros 0.643098123844866, 0.563172834083287 and 0.583088384937917; each task has 300 accepted observations including ten initial, batch ten and zero external invalid/duplicate proposals. Its own Parent contrast is only +0.0007834645552323346, with signed seed changes +0.017686193676039963, +0.002307179813052951 and -0.01764297982339591. Archived current-Parent analyses give 648 strict best-parent beats and 255 sequential incumbent advances among 4350 offspring. n-605c7a785b51 establishes the current composite selector contribution through a -0.12818290031998167 removal loss, yet more novel productive cores coexist with much weaker absolute offspring/source quality. Current squared covariance n-36a7bb9883ec improves modest selected-stream ranking and productive-core reuse but loses -0.044471550095667355. Exponential mean/residual siblings likewise have local proxy gains with endpoint losses. Historical min/max n-dd2b25d32925, normalized Matern n-ea03f38e7e10 and full exponential n-07dd356cb779 are negative exact-law contrasts on ungated n-62daf219c70a, not tests of this normalized inner product on the sulfur-gated Parent. These observations motivate a distinct fixed geometry while requiring actual absolute progress and full endpoints to test utility.
hypothesis: Replace only the inherited GP covariance with the fixed normalized-count inner product K(x,y)=(x dot y)/(sqrt(sum(x*x))*sqrt(sum(y*y))) for nonzero raw inherited Morgan count rows, with empty/empty=1 and exactly one empty=0, coherently in every training, cross, pool and probe Gram block; preserve the complete correlated posterior-sampling allocator and all noncovariance interfaces.

finding_summary.headline: Real selection changes worsen ranking and lower endpoint mean by 0.07723
finding_summary.insights:
The changed geometry and delivered choices happened, but the predicted ranking and productive-exploration benefits did not. This rules out rescuing the tested fixed law with its lower dispersion or slightly higher scaffold-win counts under this composition and profile. New-core local wins arose from weaker absolute sources and did not turn into stronger actual continuation. Draw opportunity, supported-but-undrawn sources, sources drawn without accepted descendants, nonsurvivor fitting and terminal censoring are accounted for; their overlapping ancestry does not establish independent series or chemical mediation. The exact recipe ends after this complete exposed test.

The molecular assessment shows useful aryl, amide, carbonyl and cyclic/aliphatic-amine arrangements among leaders, alongside reactive attachments, difficult bridged rings, unspecified stereochemistry, destructive fragments and excessive concatenations. The inherited sulfur gate contains its specified sulfur signatures but does not solve these broader generation gaps. These associations help describe the weak delivered chemistry; they do not identify why the covariance lost utility. Proportional count directions mathematically alias and discard magnitude, but no unequal proportional-only rows or empty rows occurred naturally, and the seven equal-count distinct-identity alias records did not form accepted-stream alias groups. Alias-mediated failure therefore remains unproved. Pool-wide calibration, passive choice rewards and genealogy, constituent interactions, causal chemistry, other profiles/compositions and unevaluated foundation models remain open.
finding_summary.results:
The kernel changed real decisions: all 435 batch orders and 434 selected sets differed from the original same-state control, with 3,176 strict disagreements under the actual masks and 2,645 newly selected accepted identities. Independent replay reconstructs the coherent GP moments and correlated draws from the original saved normal arrays. On all 4,350 actual accepted offspring labels, active MSE was 0.027650 versus 0.007503 for passive original means; within-batch pair accuracy was 0.610626 versus 0.763745, and mean batch Spearman was 0.287213 versus 0.650562. All 15 task/seed cells were adverse on these three same-label measures. These estimates describe the delivered stream, not unscored candidates.

The complete endpoint mean fell from 0.596453 to 0.519226, a signed change of -0.077227; all three seed macros and 13 of 15 endpoint cells lost. Mean AUC fell from 0.470976 to 0.413188. Macro population SD decreased from 0.033970 to 0.029462, which does not meet the registered +0.002 mean-gain requirement. Strict best-generating-parent wins decreased from 648 to 637. Productive new typed/generic cores rose slightly from 262/163 to 266/166, while mean offspring utility fell from 0.372050 to 0.305848, summed sequential incumbent gain fell from 5.819415 to 4.661015, and typed-core sources with later parent-beating descendants fell from 122 to 112. Every task completed; there was no natural fallback, numerical retry, budget or sulfur-gate violation.

molecular.headline: Aromatic and fluorinated ring families persist; more new-core local wins do not yield stronger chemistry or useful continuation
molecular.overall_character:
Node n-52bd6c308406 emits ring-rich aromatic amide/imino series, linked azaheterocycles, aryl/cyclic amines, fused nitrogen/carbonyl systems and fluorinated bridged rings. Different seeds reach different families, while leading molecules within a seed often remain close relatives. Ring-closure text incidences range 0.9345 to 0.9736 and aromatic-token incidences 0.9276 to 0.9667 across the digest; this supports rich ring/aromatic chemistry, not a claim that those fractions of atoms are aromatic. Conventional amides, ethers, carbon-bound halogens and protonatable cyclic/aliphatic amines coexist with N-F/O-halogen bonds, peroxides, halomethyl groups, cumulenes and questionable bridges. Synthetic plausibility is questionable and medicinal-chemistry quality weak; neither parsing success nor a high benchmark label proves stability, makeability or binding. Structural diversity is moderate overall, limited among leading local series, not global collapse.

All 15 actual Child and 15 published Parent trajectories, all six summaries and 30 associated logs were read completely. Both nodes have 900 records per objective: 30 initial records across three seeds and 870 accepted optimizer observations, hence 4350 generated observations each. All objectives, seeds and cited paths are covered; tasks_without_trajectories is empty. The supplied comparison is child_complete=true and paired_complete=true with no profile mismatch; baseline n-1744a1494180 is the actual current-profile code Parent. Child/Parent macro means are 0.519226455/0.596453114 and population SDs 0.029461722/0.033970330. The paired mean delta is -0.077226660; seed deltas are -0.104006356, -0.085596800 and -0.042076823. Mean AUC is 0.413188175/0.470976019. Every endpoint cell is retained in per_task, including the two positive cells (+0.013887279 and +0.001412911) and all adverse cells. Lower macro dispersion does not change the negative observed mean or the bound +0.002 literal target. This report supplies numerical and chemical context; Analyze owns activation, formal hypothesis disposition and eligibility.

The exact source/intent were read. The active feature law uses the same chirality-aware folded2048 radius-two integer Morgan occurrence counts and their unit-normalized inner product; it loses count magnitude and aliases positive rescalings. The source diff changes the FingerprintPosterior covariance and its passive diagnostics, preserving graph generation, disabled aromatic exchange, identity admission, sulfur envelope/gate, rank-quantile parent draws, greedy64 survivors, chronological archive and pool160 code. No external or foundation model is evaluated here. Reported Gram diagnostics expose nonzero/disjoint directions and seven distinct-identity equal-raw-count alias records across repeated actual blocks, but zero unequal proportional-only rows, zero empty rows and zero rounded-unit nonalias records. Independent count reconstruction over all 300 accepted identities in each of the 30 sessions finds no within-session raw-equal identity groups, unequal proportional groups or empty rows. Thus proportional aliasing is a mathematical limitation not an observed accepted-stream failure cause; equal count rows among distinct unscored pool identities expose structural nonuniqueness without showing chemical or score mediation. Folding/native-radius ambiguities are not disentangled. Passive alternatives have no labels or descendants.

Offline RDKit classification finds zero absolute outside-envelope sulfur centres in either accepted generated stream. Actual Child gate receipts have 69600 allows and 92 rejects; five task/seed cells have no rejection exposure. The inherited relative rule uses a maximum for each signature across original scored generating parents and permits the declared neutral envelope, rather than certifying arbitrary sulfur chemistry. Child/Parent sulfur-containing observation counts are 861/1100, sulfur-halogen bond counts 20/93 and N-S bond counts 350/306. N-halogen counts are 630/786, O-halogen 288/217, peroxide O-O 147/128, and perceived cumulated-double centres occur in 170/89 molecules. These bond/graph counts are distinct from the digest's lexical cumulated-bond rates. Child/Parent unassigned potential tetrahedral-centre molecule counts are 2407/2455; neither has a specified centre in these generated streams. Neutral notation also occurs for clearly protonatable amines, so missing charge text does not mean missing basic centres. Child has 114 molecules with at most three heavy atoms versus Parent 82, and 192 empty Murcko cores versus 111; empty/acyclic records are kept separate from ring-core novelty.

Productive means strictly better than the best ORIGINAL scored generating parent, not merely better than one weaker parent. Child has 637 wins, 240 ties and 3473 losses versus Parent 648, 186 and 3516. Summed positive parent gain is 11.964980609 versus 17.251535286 and sequential incumbent gain 4.661015155 versus 5.819415049; frozen pre-batch incumbent beats are 338 versus 370. Across equally weighted accepted records the best-source/offspring absolute means are 0.398309034/0.305848316 for Child versus 0.455304045/0.372049561 for Parent, with task cells in per_task and full operator/phase/distance cells in support evidence. Cross-objective raw aggregates are descriptive and do not define cross-objective rank pairs. Newly accepted nonempty typed/generic Murcko cores with strict parent gains number 266/166 versus Parent 262/163. Their typed-source/offspring means are 0.279730/0.295908 versus Parent 0.316336560/0.337222558; generic means are 0.257001222/0.272751340 versus 0.308055607/0.326992295. Extra new-core local wins therefore coexist with weaker absolute molecular utility. Typed-core cohort summed sequential gain is 1.799768266 versus Parent 2.187436382; generic is 1.333071038 versus 1.452230621. Core novelty is chronological relative to all earlier accepted initial/generated identities, not a tally of independently discovered chemical series.

Actual future use is conditional on original breeding opportunity. Of 266 Child productive typed-core sources, four final-batch sources are terminally censored. All 262 nonterminal sources have later survivor support; 261 have positive original parent-draw support and are actually drawn. Of these, 213 have accepted direct descendants, 112 have a descendant beating its own best generating parent, and 74 have an incumbent-improving descendant. Forty-eight drawn sources have no accepted descendant. Parent has 262 productive typed sources, two terminal, 260 later survivor-supported, 259 with positive draw support, 257 drawn, 215 with accepted descendants, 122 with parent-beating descendants and 84 with incumbent-improving descendants; two are positive-but-undrawn and 42 drawn-without-accepted-descendant. Generic-cohort counts are Child 166 total/one terminal, 165 supported and drawn, 135 accepted-descendant sources, 70 productive-descendant sources and 50 incumbent-descendant sources; Parent 163/one terminal, 162 supported, 160 drawn, 134/78/60 descendant source counts. Child's extra local core wins do not become stronger productive continuation in aggregate. Direct offspring with two sources are shared; these source counts overlap and are not independent credit or additive genealogy effects. Final-batch sources cannot be classed as failed later use. All nonsurvivors still belong to the chronological fit archive.

Accepted identities active-added relative to the passive original selected set number 2645, and retained-set identities 1705. Added/retained sources produce 124/142 typed and 76/90 generic new-core parent wins, with sequential gains 1.610547251/3.050467904 and absolute source/offspring means 0.425488497/0.313253906 versus 0.356145000/0.294359880. There are 107/43 terminal sources. Among 2538/1662 nonterminal sources, later survivor support is 1802/1424, positive draw support 1220/1121, actual draws 1177/1106, accepted-descendant sources 666/698, productive-descendant sources 233/284 and incumbent-descendant sources 109/136. Positive-undrawn counts are 43/15; drawn-without-accepted-descendant 511/408; no-later-survivor-support 736/238. These actual continued Child cohorts can be described, but no reward or genealogy is imputed to unselected passive alternatives.

Identity-bound pre-label active/passive means are joined to all 4350 actual accepted labels. Raw MSE is 0.027649730 versus passive original 0.007502549 and archive-mean 0.028855656. Unequal-label pair accuracy, pooled only within task/seed sessions, is 0.731274935 versus 0.841875989 over 627381 pairs; 1194 label ties are retained separately and prediction ties receive half credit. Average-rank mean batch Spearman is 0.287212934 versus 0.650561774 over 435 batches with zero null/constant batches in this panel. Each of the 15 task/seed cells has worse active MSE, pair accuracy and session Spearman than the passive original on these same labels; all signed cells are in per_task. Phase, operator, distance, added/retained cohorts and each batch, including adverse cells, remain in evidence.json and its accepted joins. This is selected-stream predictive evidence, not pool-wide calibration, passive choice reward, model-family universality or causal mediation. No whole-foundation-model inference, component contribution, transfer, interaction, partial L07 composition or full-history closure follows. The gap history below preserves its original source and current-profile conditions. Full support and input hashes are in .slots/round-0028-slot-0/molecular/evidence.json; validation checks the canonical response against the immutable request rather than any staging copy.

transferable_gaps.evidence: The local-bond gap originates in n-c55c3d520a2c, is carried by n-62daf219c70a and n-1744a1494180, and recurs in n-52bd6c308406 against that current-profile Parent on the complete Search seeds 0/1/2 at 300 observations per objective. In the Child accepted stream, 630 of 4350 molecules contain N-halogen bonds, 288 O-halogen bonds, 147 O-O bonds, 20 S-halogen bonds and 350 N-S bonds. Conventional carbon-bound fluorination, aryl amides and cyclic/aliphatic amines are also present among leaders; neither reactive attachments nor a blanket ban on those useful functional families is justified by labels.
transferable_gaps.gap: Useful local graph chemistry is not consistently expressed through conventional bond environments in delivered molecules.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A separate task-agnostic generator proposal would need environment-sensitive edits and conventional substituent alternatives that preserve useful functional-group relationships. Keep the inherited sulfur rule distinct from general stability, and evaluate actual plausible output and absolute utility. This observation does not attribute the gap to the covariance component or authorize tuning the tested fixed law.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Ring-geometry and stereochemical gaps originate in n-c55c3d520a2c and are re-observed through n-62daf219c70a and n-1744a1494180 in n-52bd6c308406 under the supplied current profile and complete Search panel. Ring-rich leaders coexist with small unsaturated/bridged rings, fused medium rings and cumulated bonds. RDKit finds potential tetrahedral centres in 2407 of 4350 Child generated observations and 2455 Parent observations, with zero specified-centre molecules in both. Other leaders have no potential centre and conventional saturated amines occur, so the gap is conditional on generated topology, not an absence of rings or universal stereochemistry requirement.
transferable_gaps.gap: Ring generation does not consistently preserve credible geometry and explicit stereochemical identity.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A future task-agnostic graph proposal should represent ring size, unsaturation and bridge connectivity faithfully and preserve or resolve meaningful stereochemistry. Assess geometry, stereoisomer identity, protonation and tautomerism separately. Valence-valid graphs, ring-core novelty and sulfur containment cannot substitute for those chemical checks.

transferable_gaps.evidence: The context-retention gap originates in n-c55c3d520a2c and is carried by n-62daf219c70a and n-1744a1494180. It recurs in n-52bd6c308406 on the complete current-profile panel: 114 Child generated observations have at most three heavy atoms versus Parent 82, while large repeated heterocyclic assemblies can lie at extreme score floors. Successful families combine aryl, heterocyclic, carbonyl or amine regions; compact improving counterexamples show simplification is possible, and raw size/ring totals are not universally rewarded.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator does not reliably preserve useful multi-region context while avoiding destructive fragmentation and excessive concatenation.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A new task-agnostic proposal should preserve interacting functional-group regions during recombination while allowing coherent simplification and distinct plausible alternatives. Evaluate absolute source/offspring utility and retained useful context rather than targeting molecular size alone. This molecular association does not identify one causal operator or justify a post-result rescue of the fixed covariance recipe.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Limited local leading-family alternatives were documented in n-c55c3d520a2c and carried through n-62daf219c70a and n-1744a1494180. In n-52bd6c308406 versus its current-profile Parent, productive new typed/generic core counts are 266/166 versus 262/163, but absolute productive typed-cohort offspring means are 0.295908229 versus 0.337222558. Later parent-beating descendant-source counts are 112 versus 122 typed and 70 versus 78 generic, after excluding four/two typed and one/one generic terminal sources. More local scaffold counts coexist with weaker source/offspring levels, summed incumbent gains and useful continuation; shared descendants do not create independent series.
transferable_gaps.gap: New ring-core local wins are not consistently continued into stronger plausible molecular families.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A separate task-agnostic search proposal would need to generate and retain plausible alternative structures with real absolute gains and actual productive continuation. Preserve opportunity, nonsurvivor fitting, undrawn/drawn-without-descendant states, terminal censoring and shared ancestry when checking it. Core labels and novelty alone cannot identify chemical mediation or component contribution.

transferable_gaps.evidence: This limitation is attached specifically to n-52bd6c308406 and its bound normalized-count inner-product law under the current gated generator and Search panel. Unit normalization discards magnitude and mathematically aliases positive rescalings. Actual diagnostics show seven distinct-identity equal-raw-count alias records across repeated archive/pool blocks, but no unequal proportional-only or empty-row exposure; independent accepted-session reconstruction finds no exact or unequal proportional identity groups. All 15 selected-stream task/seed comparisons have worse active rank and MSE than passive original means on the same actual labels. These observations do not establish aliasing as the cause, and they leave pool-wide calibration and unscored passive outcomes unidentified.
transferable_gaps.gap: The selection representation does not uniquely identify global molecular arrangements or preserve overall environment-count magnitude.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Any separately authorized future task-agnostic representation proposal should distinguish local count direction from magnitude and whole-graph arrangement, retain exact alias/missing-exposure accounting, and test prospective accepted-label ordering together with absolute productive chemistry. Do not infer unique structures from unit similarity, infer alias mediation from adverse labels, repeat/tune this fixed law after its exposed result, or generalize to unevaluated foundation models.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
